issues.description: The template implementation of simulate_msd_two_rounds incorrectly constructs a Stim Circuit with an extra parameter (circ = stim.Circuit(p)) before the function docstring. The Stim Circuit constructor is used without arguments elsewhere (solution uses stim.Circuit()), and the problem description and other functions expect creating an empty stim.Circuit(). Passing p into stim.Circuit in the template is a mismatched parameter usage and may raise an error or confuse students when they call the function.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the incorrect parameter from the Stim Circuit construction in the template. Change the line 'circ = stim.Circuit(p)' to 'circ = stim.Circuit()' (and ensure the function docstring is the first statement in the function). This aligns the template with the solution and the expected usage described in the problem statement.
